declaration: written before new driving runs; follows explicit user requirement for a programmed simulator
engine: Gymnasium Car.step and Box2D world.Step at 50 Hz, independent reconstructed worlds

uncertain_choices.contact: five wheel footprint samples; approximate reconstructed geometry contacts
uncertain_choices.hidden_state: carry selected first imagined wheel state; correct observed hull velocity and yaw; no true wheel state
uncertain_choices.solver: fresh worlds discard contact/constraint warm-start impulses
uncertain_choices.road: one straight continuation, no calibrated distribution yet
uncertain_choices.score: retain existing handcrafted progress/penalty score to isolate engine and candidate changes
uncertain_choices.runtime: two independent CPU evaluation jobs; cost is not an isolated latency benchmark

interpretation: same-candidate bounded engine comparison first; wider family is a separate intervention, not a pure model effect
